rule.statement: The trial Court cannot conclude that the transfer of the property by the defendant to the plaintiffs should form a transaction in the form of a constructive trust as envisaged under section 83 of the Trust Ordinance.
rule.supporting_quote: I find that these attendant circumstances taken together cannot form a basis for the trial Court to conclude that the transfer of the property by the defendant to the plaintiffs should form a transaction in the form of a constructive trust as envisaged under section 83 of the Trust Ordinance.
